## Summary

Debarjun Thakur is a Frontend Developer and AI Systems Builder who engineers
fast web experiences that feel like polished product work with a sketchbook
soul. He specializes in frontend systems, motion and tactile interfaces,
technical SEO, Core Web Vitals, and AI-powered tooling. He is the primary
frontend engineer for Raen AI's web presence and has shipped production
products, CRM portals, auth flows, and real-time interfaces. He also runs a
student developer community and has competed at a national level in India.

## Professional Experience

### Frontend Developer, Raen AI — May 2024 to Present

- Primary frontend engineer for Raen AI web properties: marketing pages,
  product interfaces, and internal platforms.
- Drove technical SEO across structured metadata, Core Web Vitals, semantic
  hierarchy, and indexing strategy; helped Raen AI rank #1 on Google for its
  primary brand keyword.
- Owned website performance optimization: load time, asset delivery, rendering
  efficiency, and responsive behavior.
- Led frontend development of the GarageView CRM web portal including
  authentication flows, real-time data interfaces, and responsive production
  delivery.

### Freelance Software Developer — 2023 to May 2024

- Delivered end-to-end web and software projects for private businesses and
  NGOs.
- Managed requirements, scoping, development, testing, and client handoff
  independently across concurrent client codebases.

## Projects

### FastFox

AI-powered command-line productivity assistant. Uses Groq, LLaMA 3, Mixtral
8x7B, and Salesforce BLIP to organize files, generate terminal commands,
generate/explain code, and analyze documents (PDFs, spreadsheets, text,
images). Stack: Python, Groq LLMs, BLIP, Pandas, PyPDF2, Win32 APIs.
https://github.com/Itshardtofindagoodname/fastfox

### GitGud

AI-fabricated GitHub repository history generator. Writes complete multi-file
codebases using Groq and Gemini LLMs, then fabricates realistic backdated
commit histories and publishes them to GitHub via the REST API. Handles empty
repositories, preset and custom date ranges.
https://github.com/Itshardtofindagoodname/gitgud

### Tornedo

Local-first, terminal-native, federated torrent search and download client.
Federates 10+ sources concurrently with fault isolation, dedupes and ranks
results, ships a crash-recovering WebTorrent engine with resume/seeding, and a
configurable Ink + React TUI. State lives in local SQLite.
https://github.com/Itshardtofindagoodname/Tornedo

### Vaultify

Blockchain-powered legal document custody platform with role-based access
control for clients, lawyers, and judges. React + Vite + Tailwind, Thirdweb
SDK, decentralized file handling. https://github.com/Itshardtofindagoodname/Vaultify-SIH

### Slash

Browser-native arcade game shipped without a game engine, built with vanilla
JavaScript, HTML, and CSS. https://github.com/Itshardtofindagoodname/Slash

### Cairn

Federated dataset, model, paper, and code search engine ("Google for open data
and ML"). Fans out to Hugging Face, arXiv, GitHub, Zenodo, Semantic Scholar,
data.gov, OpenML, and Kaggle in parallel, streams results over SSE, ranks with
explainable weighted signals, and scores reproducibility. Next.js + TypeScript.
https://github.com/Itshardtofindagoodname/Cairn
